B1_C_PATCH_REPORT.patch_summary: Added GAK policy preflight inside _tool01_router() before permission grant or execution. When TOOL-01 pattern matches, detect_action_intent() and evaluate_action_policy() are invoked first. If GAK policy returns blocked_by_policy=True, TOOL-01 returns early with blocked_by_policy flag and skips permission request/execution. Preserves existing permission_required flow for safe workspace paths.
B1_C_PATCH_REPORT.behavior_change: TOOL-01 now enforces GAK policy before executing or requesting permission. Protected paths and policy-blocked actions are blocked immediately. Safe workspace paths unchanged. allow_once/allow_session/deny flow preserved.
